implementation.name: Neo Geo (MiSTer)
implementation.notes: Source availability (T5.4): open -- the repository carries 157 HDL source files (9 systemverilog, 137 verilog, 11 vhdl) alongside 40 prebuilt .rbf binaries. There is no open_source column in the delivered schema (data-model.md §1.9 deleted the proposed core table together with its flags); the presence of hdl_language_id and of implementation_path rows is how that fact is stated here. Machine mapping: hand-mapped, not MRA-setname-derived -- a console core ships no MRA files. The core reimplements the Neo Geo MVS arcade board and the AES home console, both of which the core boots, giving machine_id neogeo and machine_id aes. Every id was checked against extract/machine.json. License: https://github.com/MiSTer-devel/NeoGeo_MiSTer/blob/master/LICENSE is the verbatim GNU GPL version 2 text, and the grant in https://github.com/MiSTer-devel/NeoGeo_MiSTer/blob/master/neogeo.sv reads "either version 2 of the License, or (at your option) any later version" -- hence GPL-2.0-or-later. hdl_language_id: no single HDL family reaches 90% of the 157 source files (9 systemverilog, 137 verilog, 11 vhdl), excluding the shared framework directory. accuracy_id omitted: the repository makes no timing-fidelity claim this build could verify.
